mathematical_outcomes.result: For finite conjugation-closed nodes and strictly positive real weights on those nodes, every real polynomial of degree below the node cardinality has nonnegative real part of its signed square trace iff every node is real.
mathematical_outcomes.constructive_obstruction: A nonreal conjugate pair admits an interpolating real polynomial with trace exactly minus the sum of the pair weights.
mathematical_outcomes.auxiliary_result: Equal conjugate weights imply the complete signed trace is real, with no sign requirement. Arbitrary real weights at real nodes give a real sum, not necessarily a nonnegative sum.
edge_cases: empty node set via degree bottom
arbitrary unequal positive conjugate weights for real-part criterion
unequal conjugate weights can produce nonreal trace
